protocol.warning: These inputs come from the legacy 40-door probe (`validate_usd_isaacsim.py`: a fixed 60 N*m / 60 N push plus 8 N*m on the operator for 400 steps, position targets zeroed every step) adapted to the parity schema by `scripts/isaaclab/probe_to_parity.py`, with qa.json as the MuJoCo side. The protocols differ (adaptive QA push, latch coupling, spring targets), so every class below is a hypothesis about the probe as much as about the door; the numbers are replaced when `doorbench/parity/protocol.py` runs on the GPU.

OK.label: parity
OK.meaning: every applicable phase agrees within tolerance

QUANT.label: quantitative
QUANT.meaning: both simulators reach the same pass / fail verdicts but at least one metric is outside tolerance
QUANT.root_cause: soft MuJoCo contacts / limits (solref 0.005) vs rigid PhysX limits, constraint-based vs effort-based Coulomb friction, implicitfast vs implicit drives at high damping; solver dt
QUANT.fix: rerun at Isaac dt 1/240 (32/8 iterations) and MuJoCo dt 0.001; if the delta shrinks below tolerance tag SOLVER_SENSITIVITY, else triage by phase

EXPORT_COUPLING.label: operator -> latch coupling missing
EXPORT_COUPLING.meaning: the operator turns but the bolt does not retract (or does not return) in PhysX, so the door stays latched
EXPORT_COUPLING.root_cause: H1: the MJCF one-sided tendon (bolt_q >= scale * operator_q) is exported only as doorbench:couplings JSON / doorbench:latch_coupling; the runner must emulate it as a kinematic clamp each step (the soft target offset under-retracts by 40-60 %)
EXPORT_COUPLING.fix: shared clamp function (write_joint_state_to_sim(max(latch_q, scale * op_q))) in the parity runner and DoorMechanismAction; read scale from doorbench:rl.latch_coupling / doorbench:latch_coupling_scale

EXPORT_WELD.label: holding constraint missing in USD
EXPORT_WELD.meaning: MuJoCo holds the leaf (weld / lock equality) but PhysX has nothing holding it, so the door opens under the push
EXPORT_WELD.root_cause: H5: weld-type lock equalities (mag_lock / delayed_egress leaf -> world) are exported only as doorbench:couplings JSON; write_usd_rl keeps door_hinge active with its full range
EXPORT_WELD.fix: author a FixedJoint / locked drive (or a D6 joint with breakForce = holding_force_N) tagged doorbench:env_release that DoorMechanismAction disables on REX / badge / timer; classify env_release_only and test 'holds' in both sims

EXPORT_FRAME.label: export frame / COM / axis
EXPORT_FRAME.meaning: body origins, COMs or joint anchors / axes differ between the MJCF and the USD at q0
EXPORT_FRAME.root_cause: usd.py frame composition (zero_offset, quaternion order, axis sign) or canonical-link welding in write_usd_rl
EXPORT_FRAME.fix: compare pose0 per body against model.json; fix the offending transform in doorbench/export/usd.py

PHYSICS_PARAM.label: physics parameter mapping
PHYSICS_PARAM.meaning: the same mechanism behaves differently because a joint parameter maps differently (spring target / preload, friction, damping, mass)
PHYSICS_PARAM.root_cause: H2 / D1 / D2: position targets written as zeros erase every USD drive target (springref preload) -> levers sag, closer preload lost, counterbalance lost; H3: joint Coulomb friction double-authored (legacy coefficient + per-axis efforts) or ignored
PHYSICS_PARAM.fix: runner writes set_joint_position_target = spring target every step; read back stiffness / damping / friction / armature / mass against model.json before dynamics; author physxJoint:jointFriction = 0 for Isaac Sim >= 5.0

PHYSICS_PARAM_PRELOAD.label: spring preload lost
PHYSICS_PARAM_PRELOAD.meaning: settle drift or a false opening that matches a spring whose target was zeroed (operator sag q = tau_g / k, closer preload gone)
PHYSICS_PARAM_PRELOAD.root_cause: H2 / D1: Isaac Lab forwards zero position targets to the PhysX drives; the USD targetPosition (springref) is lost while the stiffness stays
PHYSICS_PARAM_PRELOAD.fix: restore doorbench:target_si / rl joints[*].target each step (as DoorMechanismAction does); report drift per joint

PHYSICS_PARAM_FRICTION.label: friction / push magnitude
PHYSICS_PARAM_FRICTION.meaning: a free-swinging door opens in one simulator but not the other (timing or threshold), pointing at Coulomb friction or gravity bias mapping
PHYSICS_PARAM_FRICTION.root_cause: H3: physxJointAxis friction efforts vs MuJoCo frictionloss (stick / slip differs), legacy jointFriction coefficient adding load-dependent friction, or an effort below the adaptive QA push
PHYSICS_PARAM_FRICTION.fix: measure breakaway effort on one door in both sims; use the per-door qa_push; zero the legacy coefficient

PHYSICS_PARAM_DAMPING.label: closer spring / damping mapping
PHYSICS_PARAM_DAMPING.meaning: the closer returns the door at a different speed or not at all
PHYSICS_PARAM_DAMPING.root_cause: H2: closer target (springref, about -2 rad) erased or drive gains converted differently; explicit asymmetric damping at 120 Hz
PHYSICS_PARAM_DAMPING.fix: keep spring targets; implicit damping via write_joint_damping_to_sim; dt <= 1/240

CONTACT_GEOMETRY.label: geometry / contact behaves differently under PhysX
CONTACT_GEOMETRY.meaning: the bolt retracted (or there is no bolt) yet the leaf did not move, or a latch that holds in MuJoCo does not engage in PhysX (convex hulls, strike lip, panel clearance)
CONTACT_GEOMETRY.root_cause: H7: PhysX contacts with Env prims at 0-5 mm clearance (contactOffset 5 mm), convex decomposition of hooks / strikes, self-collision disabled globally vs MuJoCo's selective exclusion
CONTACT_GEOMETRY.fix: enable contact reporting; rerun with Env collision disabled, then without the hardware part, to bisect frame contact vs articulation; author PhysxFilteredPairsAPI for model.contact_excludes

RL_CANON.label: canonical RL export (welded / omitted parts, slot logic)
RL_CANON.meaning: door.usda agrees with MuJoCo but door_rl.usda does not: a welded lock / operator / panel or an empty operator slot changes the behaviour
RL_CANON.root_cause: H4: panic doors with robot outside and no far-side trim get operator_joint None (exit device welded, latch never retracts); engaged locks welded; world-mounted latches welded released; extra leaves omitted
RL_CANON.fix: derive the RL expectation from doorbench:rl (lock.engaged, operator_slot_joint) and document 'holds by construction'; or map the release to a canonical slot

VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL.label: protocol / runner
VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL.meaning: the effort, schedule or expectation applied by a runner does not match the protocol (fixed 60 N*m instead of the adaptive push, 8 N on a slide operator, wrong lock expectation)
VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL.root_cause: H3 / H4 / H6: fixed efforts below the door's static load (rollup 942 N, hatch 687 N*m, slider friction 95-157 N, drop bolt 12.6 N) or the expectation 'must open' for doors with no robot-side release
VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL.fix: consume protocol_inputs/<door>.json (qa_push, operator efforts by joint type, door_flags expectations) in both runners

REFERENCE_QA_FAILURE.label: reference does not reproduce qa.json
REFERENCE_QA_FAILURE.meaning: MuJoCo itself fails a phase that qa.json marks as passed
REFERENCE_QA_FAILURE.root_cause: protocol drift from qa.py (schedule, efforts, reset) or nondeterminism
REFERENCE_QA_FAILURE.fix: align the MuJoCo runner with qa.py before comparing to PhysX

SOLVER_SENSITIVITY.label: solver sensitivity
SOLVER_SENSITIVITY.meaning: the discrepancy disappears at a finer time step / more solver iterations
SOLVER_SENSITIVITY.root_cause: integration / contact solver differences, not a dataset bug
SOLVER_SENSITIVITY.fix: record; keep the finer settings for the gate if cheap

LIMITS.label: joint left its range
LIMITS.meaning: a joint exceeded its authored range (plus tolerance) in one simulator
LIMITS.root_cause: hard PhysX limits on a heavy gravity-loaded joint parked at the limit, mimic units (rad vs deg gearing) driving a prismatic to its stop, or soft MuJoCo limits
LIMITS.fix: per-joint min / max per phase; check mimic gearing units on rot <-> trans couplings

SANITY.label: numerical health
SANITY.meaning: non-finite state, velocity cap hit (explosion) or a body flew away in one simulator
SANITY.root_cause: stiff latch / lock drives at 120 Hz, initial penetration, mass / inertia rejected by PhysX
SANITY.fix: dt <= 1/240; compare initial penetration; apply the MJCF inertia triangle guard in usd.py

LOAD_ERROR.label: not comparable (load / spawn / structure)
LOAD_ERROR.meaning: the USD failed to spawn, or its joints / limits / gains do not match model.json, so no dynamic phase can be compared
LOAD_ERROR.root_cause: export or Isaac Lab API problem

UNTESTED.label: untested
UNTESTED.meaning: no Isaac result for this door and kind
UNTESTED.fix: run the Isaac runner on the GPU pod
